title: Strict transform of a quasi-coherent module
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_S$ be a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal [pqf-def-coherent], and let $b:S^b=\operatorname{Bl}_{\mathcal I}(S)\to S$ be its blowup [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Write $E=b^{-1}V(\mathcal I)$ for the exceptional closed subscheme. Let $p:X\times_SS^b\to X$ and $q:X\times_SS^b\to S^b$ be the projections [def-pc-fibre-product]. For a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent], its strict transform relative to this centre is the quotient $\mathcal F^b=p^*\mathcal F/\mathcal K$, where $\mathcal K$ is the subsheaf of local sections whose restriction to the complement of $q^{-1}E$ is zero. Here $p^*$ denotes pullback of module sheaves (extension of scalars from the inverse image of $\mathcal O_X$ to $\mathcal O_{X\times_SS^b}$). The definition retains the centre $\mathcal I$, not merely the morphism $b$.
